code:
# The dev container: Node 22 (for Wrangler), git, OpenCode, and Oh My Pi. It sees one folder.
FROM node:22-bookworm
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates curl \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Pinned versions, so the box you build next month behaves like the one in the tutorial.
RUN npm install -g --no-audit --no-fund opencode-ai@1.19.5 bun@1.4.4
RUN BUN_INSTALL=/opt/omp bun install -g "@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@18.20.0" \
 && ln -sfn /opt/omp/install/global/node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/dist/cli.js /usr/local/bin/omp \
 && chmod -R a+rX /opt/omp
RUN mkdir -p /work && chmod 777 /work
WORKDIR /work
CMD ["bash"]
description: Node 22-based container with git, OpenCode, and Oh My Pi installed at pinned versions, mounting only one folder.

steps.description: Complete Dockerfile for the dev container.
Base: Node 22-bookworm as the foundation for Wrangler.
Apt: install git, ca-certificates, curl, then clean apt lists to minimize image.
Pinned tools: opencode-ai@1.19.5 and bun@1.4.4 installed globally with no audit/fund.
Oh My Pi: BUN_INSTALL path, global install of @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@18.20.0, symlink to /usr/local/bin/omp.
Workspace: mkdir /work with 777 permissions, WORKDIR /work, CMD bash.
